tools.name: searchProducts
tools.description:
Search for products available in the German dm-drogerie market (online and local stores).

		USE WHEN: searching dm-drogerie products by name, category, ingredient, property, or any
		natural language query (any language supported). Often answers questions about
		ingredients and properties directly

tools.name: getStoreAvailability
tools.description:
Check whether one or more dm-drogeriemarkt products are available in one or more
            specific stores right now.

            USE WHEN: you need to know if one or more products can currently be bought in one or
            more particular physical stores.

            INPUT: one to five store

tools.name: findNearbyStores
tools.description: Findet dm-Märkte in der Nähe eines Ortes. Erfordert eine eindeutig identifizierbare Ortsangabe (Stadt, Stadtteil, PLZ, Straße mit Stadt oder vollständige Adresse mit Stadt). Bei Straßenname ohne Stadt oder mehrdeutigen Angaben das Tool NICHT aufrufen, sondern Rückfrage stellen. Tool genau einmal pro

tools.name: getProductDetails
tools.description:
Retrieve detailed product information for dm-drogeriemarkt products.

USE WHEN: ingredients, nutrition facts, allergens, usage instructions,
warnings, hazard info, product URLs/images

INPUT: DANs (7 digits, preferred) and/or GTINs (8-14 digits)
multiple products can be requested at once min 1 / max

tools.name: renderProductTiles
tools.description:
Retrieve dm-drogeriemarkt products and render them as a visual card grid
(product image, brand, name, link to the product page).

USE WHEN: the user wants to see products, an overview of several products,
or a picture/link instead of a text description

INPUT: DANs (7 digits, preferred) and/or GTINs

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "getStoreAvailability" stacks urgency/override words (important, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
